EnhancementTreeItem.Name: Bombardier: Alchemical Resistance
EnhancementTreeItem.Description: +1 Fortitude save. Each core ability you take in this tree beyond the first grants +5 Fire, Cold, Acid, Electric, and Poison Spell Power, as well as +1 Burning Ambition Dice.

EnhancementTreeItem.Name: Bombardier: Multivial
EnhancementTreeItem.Description: Passive: +4 Intelligence, +2 Conjuration DCs. While in Pyrite Reaction, you gain +2% Fire, Cold, Electric, Acid, and Poison Spell Critical Damage.

EnhancementSelection.Description: Passive: +4 Intelligence, +2 Conjuration DCs. While in Pyrite Reaction, you gain +2% Fire, Cold, Electric, Acid, and Poison Spell Critical Damage. Unlike the multivial spells, this ability requires a target.

EnhancementTreeItem.Name: Bombardier: Spellvial Selection I
EnhancementTreeItem.Description: Select an Element to specialize in.

EnhancementSelection.Name: SLA: Vial Smash Acid
EnhancementSelection.Description:
SLA: Vial of Acid Metamagic: Empower, Maximize, Quicken, Heighten, Enlarge, Eschew Materials Spell Point Cost: 1 Cooldown 4 seconds Primer Element: Crimsonite
Conjuring a bottle of caustic liquid, you throw a projectile at a single foe that deals 2 to 7 Acid damage per caster level, max caster level 20.
DND Dice: Deals 1d6+1 Acid damage per caster level, max 20d6+10

EnhancementSelection.Name: SLA: Vial Smash Cold
EnhancementSelection.Description:
SLA: Vial Smash: Cold Metamagic: Empower, Maximize, Quicken, Heighten, Enlarge, Eschew Materials Spell Point Cost: 1 Cooldown 4 seconds Primer Element: Crimsonite
Conjuring a bottle of freezing liquid, you throw a projectile at a single foe that deals 2 to 7 Cold damage per caster level, max caster level 20.
DND Dice: Deals 1d6+1 Cold damage per caster level, max 20d6+10

EnhancementSelection.Name: SLA: Vial Smash Poison
EnhancementSelection.Description:
SLA: Vial Smash: Poison Metamagic: Empower, Maximize, Quicken, Heighten, Enlarge, Eschew Materials Spell Point Cost: 1 Cooldown 4 seconds Primer Element: Crimsonite
Conjuring a bottle of magical poison, you throw a projectile at a single foe that deals 2 to 7 Poison damage per caster level, max caster level 20. This poison will leave the enemy Contaminated.
DND Dice: Deals 1d6+1 Poison damage per caster level, max 20d6+10

EnhancementSelection.Name: SLA: Vial Smash Electric
EnhancementSelection.Description:
SLA: Vial Smash: Electric Metamagic: Empower, Maximize, Quicken, Heighten, Enlarge, Eschew Materials Spell Point Cost: 1 Cooldown 4 seconds Primer Element: Crimsonite
Conjuring a bottle of reactive material, you throw a projectile at a single foe that deals 2 to 7 Electric damage per caster level, max caster level 20.
DND Dice: Deals 1d6+1 Electric damage per caster level, max 20d6+10

EnhancementSelection.Name: SLA: Vial Smash Fire
EnhancementSelection.Description:
SLA: Vial Smash: Fire Metamagic: Empower, Maximize, Quicken, Heighten, Enlarge, Eschew Materials Spell Point Cost: 1 Cooldown 4 seconds Primer Element: Crimsonite
Conjuring a bottle of burning liquid, you throw a projectile at a single foe that deals 2 to 7 Fire damage per caster level, max caster level 20.
DND Dice: Deals 1d6+1 Fire damage per caster level, max 20d6+10

EnhancementSelection.Name: SLA: Corrode Weapons
EnhancementSelection.Description:
SLA: Corrode Weapons Metamagic: Empower, Maximize, Quicken, Heighten, Enlarge, Eschew Materials Spell Point Cost: 1 Cooldown 4 seconds Primer Element: Gildleaf
Lob a vial of caustic liquid at a single foe that deals heavy damage and corrodes the weapons of whatever it strikes. Deals 5 to 10 Acid damage per caster level, to a single target and reduces their accuracy and Melee and Ranged Power by 4 for 15 seconds +2 seconds per Caster Level. A successful Reflex save reduces the damage by half.

EnhancementSelection.Name: SLA: Cold Spike
EnhancementSelection.Description:
SLA: Cold Spike Metamagic: Empower, Maximize, Quicken, Heighten, Enlarge, Eschew Materials Spell Point Cost: 1 Cooldown 4 seconds Primer Element: Gildleaf
Lob a vial of freezing liquid at a single foe that deals heavy damage and slows the movement of whatever it strikes. Deals 5 to 10 Cold damage per caster level, to a single target and reduces their movement speed by 30% and damage by 4 for 15 seconds +2 seconds per Caster Level. A successful Reflex save reduces the damage by half.

EnhancementSelection.Name: SLA: Melt Armor
EnhancementSelection.Description:
SLA: Melt Armor Metamagic: Empower, Maximize, Quicken, Heighten, Enlarge, Eschew Materials Spell Point Cost: 1 Cooldown 4 seconds Primer Element: Gildleaf
Lob a vial of burning liquid at a single foe that deals heavy damage and melts the armor of whatever it strikes. Deals 5 to 10 Fire damage per caster level, to a single target and reduces their Armor Class and Physical Resistance Rating by 4 for 15 seconds +2 seconds per Caster Level. A successful Reflex save reduces the damage by half.

EnhancementSelection.Name: SLA: Venom Concentration
EnhancementSelection.Description:
SLA: Melt Armor Metamagic: Empower, Maximize, Quicken, Heighten, Enlarge, Eschew Materials Spell Point Cost: 1 Cooldown 4 seconds Primer Element: Crimsonite
Conjuring a bottle of magical poison, you throw a projectile at a single foe that deals 1 to 6 Poison damage, +2 per caster level. This poison eats away at the enemy, dealing its damage every 2 seconds for 16 seconds. You may stack this poison 5 times. This poison will leave the enemy Contaminated.

EnhancementSelection.Name: SLA: Voltaic Backlash
EnhancementSelection.Description:
SLA: Voltaic Backlash Metamagic: Empower, Maximize, Quicken, Heighten, Enlarge, Eschew Materials Spell Point Cost: 1 Cooldown 4 seconds Primer Element: Gildleaf
Lob a vial of volatile liquid at a single foe that deals heavy damage and disrupts the offensive spellcasting capacity of whatever it strikes. Deals 5 to 10 Electric damage per caster level, and reduces Universal Spell Power by 10 for 15 seconds +2 seconds per Caster Level. A successful Reflex save reduces the damage by half.

EnhancementTreeItem.Name: Bombardier: Burning Ambition
EnhancementTreeItem.Description:
When your Reaction is Pyrite, your offensive Crimsonite and Gildleaf Alchemist spells will ignite your enemies with magic, dealing additional damage. This damage determines its element based on the element of the spell cast. Different elements can be ignited at the same time.
This ability begins at 1d4 damage, adding another 1d4 for each Burning Ambition die you get from other abilities. This damage scales with Spell Power.

EnhancementTreeItem.Name: Bombardier: Augmentation
EnhancementTreeItem.Description: +2 Caster Levels with Crimsonite and Gildleaf spells.
